name: nature-paper-skills
description: Revise scientific manuscripts, audit evidence and prepare reviewer responses using reusable writing workflows.

interface.longDescription: Revise manuscript passages, organize research and Review articles, audit claims and citations, and prepare responses to reviewers. Start with paper-workflow and provide your draft and supporting evidence. Skills use the tools available in your session; they do not supply experimental results or external service access.
defaultPrompt: Use paper-workflow to revise this manuscript passage, preserving measurements and figure references.
Use paper-workflow to prepare responses to these reviewer comments using the completed evidence.
